Ivy (Sales): passing SummitData to CS — 12mo, 90 seats, private deploy in us-east-1. Customer asks: SAML SSO, Splunk JSON-lines, audit retention 1yr, and low p50 for short replies. They flagged renewal sensitivity if perf gaps persist.

Rashmi (CS): thanks Ivy. assigning Tom as CSM. Ivy, quick status snapshot and blockers? i'll create the onboarding runbook and standing weekly invite.

Ivy (Sales): legal & billing signed. Onboarding started. Open items: VPC peering, customer certs, Splunk HEC endpoint & test key, KMS rotation policy. They requested a reserved small GPU pool for 9am-11am ET peak.

Tom (CSM): i'll own the runbook and be primary contact. proposed runway: day0 networking, day2 SSO & keys, day6 pilot with top-8 prompts, day12 go-live (flex). Acceptance: SSO+SSO claims live, Splunk ingestion OK, median latency <320ms for pilot prompts under pilot load.

OnboardBot: provisioning update — VPC created; private control plane queued. Remaining tasks: vpn+peering, firewall rules, certs, KMS policy, Splunk ingestion test. 4/9 complete.

Hector (Eng): reviewed the demo transcript Ivy attached — streaming stalls around token ~700. Need request_id(s) to correlate with kernel/host logs. Short-term mitigations: try redwood-medium-quant for pilot, enable prefix cache for their main template, and reserve a tiny dedicated pool for peak windows.

Mira (Support): creating CS ticket CS-9311 and adding ENG triage label. Please paste sanitized prompt(s) and any request_id values. I'll monitor for reproducible traces and escalate on >2 repros in 24h.

Ivy (Sales): sanitized snippet from the demo: `2024-09-05T14:02:11Z request_id=sd-20240905-3 model=redwood-large seq=734 latency=1360ms step=kv_fetch stream_event=stall duration=1650ms` — demo output ~920 tokens.

Hector (Eng): thanks. can SummitData run this curl from their env and paste the response header request_id so we can pull host traces?

```
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_KEY>" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<their-long-prompt>","stream":true}' -D - | head
```

Tom (CSM): action owners: Rashmi — schedule the weekly syncs and invite eng lead; Tom — runbook + training & pilot logistics; Hector — triage ENG ticket and recommend config diff (due 2024-09-09); Mira — own CS-9311 and escalation; Ivy — deliver sanitized prompts + request_ids; OnboardBot/Infra — finish peering & certs and provide VPN details.

Rashmi (CS): capturing enablement asks: 1) a private-deploy quickstart for their infra team, 2) a one-pager on quantization tradeoffs (latency vs quality), 3) runbook template for SSO + Splunk field mapping. Customer wants the one-pager before pilot.

Mira (Support): CS-9311 created, priority=high. watchers: @Hector @Tom. I'll link ENG ticket when it's created.

Hector (Eng): preliminary suggestion: redwood-medium-quant + prefix cache for their template, increase streaming socket timeout to 60s on control plane, validate dedicated pool sizing. i'll post a short config diff after repro.

OnboardBot: VPN + peering complete. Firewall PR awaiting netops approval. Splunk HEC test pending customer key.

Tom (CSM): i'll post the runbook link here once ready and schedule the standing invite. marking renewal-risk=monitor until pilot meets latency acceptance; will keep eng on the first two weekly syncs.

Ivy (Sales): thanks team, i'll upload sanitized prompts and coordinate with legal on audit SLA language. :thumbsup:

Hector (Eng): aiming for an initial triage update by 2024-09-09 EOD. :eyes:

Mira (Support): once ENG ticket exists i'll link it here and add to CS-9311.

Tom (CSM): closing the handoff; reopen if blockers before provisioning completes."
